requirements.R_CLI: Unknown flags exit 2 before mutating journal or outputs.
requirements.R_EMPTY: Empty input and --empty-check leave session/late files empty without a watermark journal.
requirements.R_GAP: On-time gap closes use event_time_ms and emit half-open [start, end).
requirements.R_TENANT: Session identity is (tenant_id, user_id) and does not merge equal user ids across tenants.
requirements.R_JOURNAL: Watermark journal is append-only with seq 1..n.
requirements.R_WATERMARK: watermark_ms = max_observed - allowed_lateness and is non-decreasing across observations and restarts.
requirements.R_LATE: Late-but-allowed events join the open session; too-late events go to late.jsonl with the comparison watermark.
requirements.R_REJECT: Malformed JSON and illegal field values fail closed into rejects.jsonl.
requirements.R_IDEMPOTENT: The same clean baseline reproduces byte-identical sessions.jsonl and late.jsonl.
requirements.R_RESTART: Reloaded journal and open-session state continue seq and in-flight sessions.
requirements.R_CONFIG: processor.json gap, lateness, and max duration change behavior.
requirements.R_INPUT_ORDER: --input tie-breaks by event_time_ms then tenant_id, user_id, event_id.
requirements.R_FEED_ORDER: --feed processes file order so out-of-order event times are preserved.
requirements.R_RESET: --reset-output truncates side outputs and does not clear the watermark journal.
requirements.R_SCHEMA: Closed session records include the contract fields and event_count equals len(event_ids).
requirements.R_WAREHOUSE: The production click dump stays in place at warehouse scale.
requirements.R_CONTRACT: run-sessions remains the Python CLI and the session contract stays binding.
requirements.R_OPS: Successful runs refresh last_run.json and ops-report.json from the warehouse catalog.
requirements.R_CATALOG_GAP: Catalog-backed enterprise tenants overlay session_gap_ms; other catalog plans keep processor.json gap.
